title: Thermal 2D axisymmetric through the ScientificModel interface and the governed path
note: Phase 4, first family: the adapter's invariants, the declared lateral boundary and window, the 3D independent check speaking only to the problem it solves, and the governed path routing each model to its own tool.

mutations.name: T2_1_the_lateral_boundary_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: an adiabatic run is solved with the cold contact -- and the 3D check still passes, since that mismatched comparison is small (the reduction module's own warning)

mutations.name: T2_2_the_window_is_always_the_pulse_window
mutations.rationale: an averaged run simulates the pulse window

mutations.name: T2_3_only_the_final_field_is_counted
mutations.rationale: a non-finite peak field is not counted

mutations.name: T2_5_only_a_positive_imbalance_counts
mutations.rationale: energy lost is not an imbalance

mutations.name: T2_6_the_minimum_principle_always_holds
mutations.rationale: a cell below the fridge temperature is accepted

mutations.name: T2_7_a_failed_run_publishes_outputs
mutations.rationale: a non-converged integration publishes temperatures as OK

mutations.name: T2_8_a_cold_contact_run_is_compared
mutations.rationale: the 3D adiabatic box is compared with a cold-contact disc: different problems, reported as agreement

mutations.name: T2_9_a_pulse_run_is_compared
mutations.rationale: a pulse run is compared with an averaged 3D solve

mutations.name: T2_10_the_check_bound_is_loosened
mutations.find: status=Status.PASS if rel < REL_MAX else Status.FAIL,

mutations.name: T2_11_the_check_solves_another_window
mutations.rationale: the 3D solve is not asked for the producer's window

mutations.name: T2_12_the_check_takes_any_model
mutations.rationale: the 3D check is applied to a bundle of another model

mutations.name: T2_13_every_model_runs_under_the_1d_tool
mutations.rationale: the history says thermal 1D ran when thermal 2D did

mutations.name: T2_14_an_unknown_model_is_submitted
mutations.rationale: a model with no governed tool reaches the executor and leaves history

mutations.name: T2_15_the_catalog_omits_the_2d_check
mutations.rationale: the admitted check cannot be resolved, so no 2D result can be checked
